search_intent: Compare FOB and CIF quotations for Chinese vehicles imported into a specific Latin American market
buyer_task: Compare a China->Latin-America FOB vs CIF vehicle quote through to first registration; separate port/customs/licensing/homologation/registration stages by country.

sources.title: International Chamber of Commerce
sources.facts_supported: Incoterms(r) 2020 Checklist: FAS/FOB maritime/inland-waterway only; FCA for any mode incl multimodal and terminal delivery; C-group (CFR/CIF/CPT/CIP) are shipment contracts - risk passes on delivery (on board) in seller's country while seller pays main carriage; under CIF seller must arrange minimum-cover cargo insurance (LMA/IUA Clauses C or similar), CIP requires all-risk cover (Clauses A).

sources.title: World Customs Organization
sources.facts_supported: WCO Valuation FAQ: invoice/transaction price is not automatically customs value; whether freight/insurance is added depends on importing country national law; customs may reject declared value after persistent doubt; six valuation methods apply in sequence (transaction value, identical, similar, deductive, computed, fallback). Scope = global framework only, proves no national rule.

sources.title: World Trade Organization
sources.facts_supported: WTO Agreement on Implementation of Article VII GATT (customs valuation); framework not re-read this session; proves no national rule.

sources.title: Receita Federal do Brasil
sources.facts_supported: Manual Aduaneiro de Importacao (updated 09/04/2026): covers Procedimentos Previos incl Licenciamento da Importacao, Duimp/DI declaration, Siscomex, fiscal classification, taxation. Confirms declaration/licensing/valuation are domestic customs procedures distinct from an Incoterm.

sources.title: Colombia VUCE / MinCIT
sources.facts_supported: VUCE Import Module electronically processes prior import registrations, licences and authorizations required before import, plus quotas. Confirms a national import-registration/licensing stage.

sources.title: Peru SUNAT (Aduanas)
sources.facts_supported: Importacion de Vehiculos: DAM via customs agent + invoice + optional insurance + B/L; NEW vehicles need vehicle ID code, Homologation Registry (Reglamento Nacional de Vehiculos Anexo V) or manufacturer/conformity certificate; USED vehicles under regular regime need Ficha Tecnica (with chartered mechanical engineer) plus a Verifying Entity inspection report confirming technical and emission LMP compliance; index covers antiguedad, kilometraje, siniestrabilidad, steering side, emissions.

sources.title: Chile - Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificacion (via ChileAtiende)
sources.organization: Chile - Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificacion (via ChileAtiende)
sources.facts_supported: Updated 01/04/2026: first registration needs original first-sale invoice (importer/manufacturer/dealer) or, for customs vehicles, the Direccion Nacional de Aduanas document proving legal import and duty payment/franchise; IVA or customs duties; green tax for light/medium vehicles; port/customs release is distinct from road registration and plate issuance.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: FOB risk transfers on board the buyer-nominated vessel; FOB/FAS are maritime-only rules.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: ICC checklist FOB maritime, risk on board.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: CIF seller pays main carriage and arranges (minimum-cover) insurance to the named LA port, but risk still transfers on board in China.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: C-group shipment contract; CIF minimum cover.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Container delivered to a terminal before loading fits FCA; insured multimodal carriage fits CIP.
Invoice price is not automatically customs value and freight treatment is a matter of national law.
WTO Customs Valuation Agreement is the global treaty basis (not reopened; no LA national rule).
Brazil treats import declaration, import licensing (Licenciamento da Importacao) and valuation as domestic customs procedures via Siscomex/Duimp, independent of the Incoterm.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Receita import manual topics incl Licenciamento, Duimp, classification.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Colombia's VUCE electronically processes prior import registrations, licences and authorizations before import.
Peru requires new vehicles to carry a homologation registry/conformity link and used vehicles a technical sheet plus verifying-entity inspection (incl emissions) before nationalization.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: SUNAT importacion vehiculos: homologacion for new; ficha tecnica + inspection for used.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Chilean first registration requires the customs document proving legal import and duty payment (or franchise) plus invoice and green tax; customs release is distinct from road registration.
claim_source_matrix.SOURCE_ORG: Chile - Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificacion (via ChileAtiende)

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Brazil's process cannot be applied to Spanish-speaking markets: BR/CO/PE/CL maintain distinct declaration, licensing, valuation and registration systems.
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Four distinct national procedures captured; no source grants regional effect.

claim_source_matrix.CLAIM: Origin preference is a claim to prove: shipment from China or a generic CO does not create a preferential rate without an applicable agreement and product-specific rule (methodology).
claim_source_matrix.EXACT_SUPPORT: Procedural guidance, not an external factual assertion; requires no external source and must not be presented as a regulation.
